name: Spy Titles
summary: A cut-paper, four-ink 1960s opening title: flat grounds that change with every location, condensed caps standing as architecture, a small profile silhouette against a giant circle, scissor-cut edges, 30° diagonals and hard cuts on the stab.

palette.use: ink black: figures, type, dark grounds
paper cream: light grounds, type on dark, strips, eye slit
signal red: the hero's tie, danger, emphasis, red grounds
mustard: the object of the chase, mustard grounds
dark red shadow paper: depth only, props on a red ground
dark mustard shadow paper: depth only, props on a mustard ground

type.case: credits in capitals; strips in sentence case
type.emphasis: the word changes ink; never italic

banned: flat vector edges: every edge is cut
spy parody gadgets, gun-barrel openings, a figure drawing a pistol, agent numbers, a tiptoeing cartoon panther
copying any real title's logo, lettering, characters, silhouettes or shots
the famous spy-theme chromatic crawl and its ending chord
an object in its ground's ink without a black backing
